about: WCW/nWo Revenge's rivals (rostertags, 2026-11-21). Revenge has no rival data of its own that is known (no Create-a-Wrestler; its ability block isn't mapped; its select groups are factions, not feuds), so these are the men's real WCW feuds of late 1997 and 1998, the time of the game, between Revenge's own men only: its folders (this collection's) and the built-in Revenge ports (hollywood_hogan, sting, goldberg ...). Each with the matches it comes from (the events' Wikipedia pages: Halloween Havoc 1997, Starrcade 1997, Souled Out 1998, SuperBrawl VIII, Uncensored 1998, Spring Stampede 1998, Bash at the Beach 1998, Road Wild 1998, Halloween Havoc 1998, Starrcade 1998). The importers copy this file into wrestlers\Revenge\rivals.json (only if none is there). Edit freely: add pairs to "rivals", or list pairs in "not_rivals" to take them out.
